name: Briefly
tagline: Briefly solves one of the most common freelance problems — vague client briefs
description: Briefly solves one of the most common freelance problems — vague client briefs. Instead of chasing clarity over WhatsApp or email, you send a unique link to your client. They fill a guided multi-step form tailored to their project type (web, branding, SEO, e-commerce, redesign), and you automatically receive : - a structured brief as a PDF, scored by AI to flag missing or vague information. - A Google Meet kickoff call gets booked automatically, and the brief syncs directly to your Notion databa
